Subject: Re: POC — aligning on hands-on session and network prep

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We'd like to get a hands-on POC session scheduled next week to validate routing behavior, run a short prompt review with our clinicians, and execute a light load test against the staging endpoints. High level asks from our side: 

- 60–90 minute working session (interactive) focused on prompt engineering, routing rules, and KV/prefix caching expectations.
- A 30-minute, modest load test (simulated concurrent users) to confirm latency & throughput assumptions.
- Staging access: sandbox account(s), API key(s) scoped to the POC, and the staging endpoint URL.
- Network allowlist: we host behind a corporate NAT; we need the IP ranges you will call from and any DNS endpoints to allow.
- Compliance: quick note on data retention during the POC and whether logs are viewable to Horizon.

Our timezone: EDT (we're flexible 10:00–16:00 EDT). Our preference is Tuesday or Thursday next week.

Attaching our internal agenda (short). Can you confirm availability and any prerequisites we should complete before the session?

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Director, Engineering — Horizon Health

Hi Sam — great to hear, and glad the intro was useful. We can run the hands-on session and a controlled load test. Proposed plan and immediate prerequisites below.

Proposed session windows (90-minute block):
- Tue 2027-05-04 13:00–14:30 EDT / 10:00–11:30 PDT
- Thu 2027-05-06 11:00–12:30 EDT / 08:00–09:30 PDT

Session agenda (tight):
1) 15m context + goals (product & Horizon ops)
2) 30m prompt review & live prompt tuning with sample records
3) 25m routing & model-variant walkthrough (canary fallback plan)
4) 20m short load test and immediate observation window

Immediate prerequisites (please complete at least 24h before session):
- Provide a sandbox account email (or allow us to create a sandbox user) so we can pre-provision API scope.
- Allowlist Redwood egress IP ranges (we will provide exact CIDRs) and open outbound TLS (443) to staging.redwood-inference.net.
- Confirm a small test dataset or sample prompts (PII-free) for prompt review.

Technical notes / what we'll provide before the session:
- A scoped API key for the sandbox (short-lived) and example curl + SDK calls.
- Staging endpoint URL: https://staging.redwood-inference.net/horizon-8891
- Egress IP ranges for allowlist: 34.88.112.0/28, 34.88.112.16/28 (these are our POC egress pools, rotate schedule will be shared).
- A 10-step load script (k6) and a short-runbook to run the 30-minute load window.

Attachments: I attached our POC checklist that outlines the prework and session expectations.

Next steps: Marissa will drop a calendar invite once you confirm which window works. Aditya: can you provision the sandbox key and paste the credential stub in the thread (secure channel to follow for the full key)? Vivek: please confirm routing demo notes and the load test configuration we'll use.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
